body.statement: Conditional on \(z_0\) and the exact path-design array, the likelihood under \(P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}\) factors into a direct replicated-regression experiment, a treated-mean experiment, and an independent finite-dimensional donor-location experiment with covariance \(\Sigma\). No convolution operator acts on the training coordinates \(X_{st}\).
body.justification: The factorization is the early-kill boundary separating a generated query location from an errors-in-variables training design.
body.gap: Mammen, Rothe, and Schienle (2012) generate every training coordinate, while Delaigle, Hall, and Meister (2008) observe classically contaminated training coordinates; neither experiment has this factorization.
body.consumer: Applied analysts can determine from data provenance whether donor uncertainty requires a Holder modulus correction or a deconvolution analysis.
